provenance.method: Scotland insomnia navigation route from current NHS inform material; diagnosis and medication authority excluded.

question: My sleep problems are persistent and I live in Scotland. Where can I start?
why_it_matters: Persistent sleep difficulty can affect daily functioning, but the appropriate route depends on cause and individual circumstances.
current_understanding: NHS inform advises contacting a GP practice when improving sleep habits has not helped or poor sleep is affecting daily life. Different causes need different assessment and treatment. ND Oracle cannot diagnose insomnia, sleep apnoea, a circadian disorder or another sleep condition.
evidence_needed: More stable Scotland-wide first-party mapping of specialist sleep-service referral where it materially differs by condition or board.
reopening_conditions: NHS Scotland sleep pathways or referral arrangements change materially.
dissent: Some people prefer self-management first; persistent or impairing symptoms can still warrant clinical review.
